summary: {resident} gives the coordinator an account in person when the written form is a barrier.
realLife: Merced County's grievance procedure offered an interview or a recording when a person requested another way to file.
gates: A resident seeks an alternative way to submit an access complaint.
inGame: needs: the facility, incident date and resident's chosen filing method.

turns.pulledBy: The resident brings a recorded account.
turns.writesBack: The recording becomes the complaint on file.

turns.what: The coordinator asks where and when the barrier arose.
turns.writesBack: The intake record identifies the site and date.
